messages.content: 请帮我生成一组多轮对话数据,里面包含了LLM function call

function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified city and state. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' if State for the city exists. 'City, Country' if State for the city doesn't exist.

unit.description: The unit of temperature for the weather report.

message.content:
下面给出一个示例多轮对话数据集（JSON 格式），每条对话都包含一次或多次 LLM 调用 `get_current_weather` 的过程。  
> **说明**：  
> - 对话中的 `assistant` 消息在调用函数时使用 `function_call` 字段；  
> - 函数返回的消息使用 `role: "function"` 并携带 `name` 与 `content`；  
> - `arguments` 与 `content` 均为合法的 JSON 字符串，需要转义双引号。

```json
[
  [
    { "role": "user", "content": "你好，请告诉我旧金山现在的天气。" },
    { "role": "assistant", "content": null, "function_call": { "name": "get_current_weather", "arguments": "{\"location\":\"San Francisco, CA\"}" } },
    { "role": "function", "name": "get_current_weather", "content": "{\"temperature\":68,\"description\":\"Sunny\",\"humidity\":45}" },
    { "role": "assistant", "content": "旧金山现在是晴朗，温度68°F，湿度45%。" }
  ],
  [
    { "role": "user", "content": "请问伦敦今天的天气怎样？" },
    { "role": "assistant", "content": null, "function_call": { "name": "get_current_weather", "arguments": "{\"location\":\"London, UK\"}" } },
    { "role": "function", "name": "get_current_weather", "content": "{\"temperature\":55,\"description\":\"Cloudy\",\"humidity\":60}" },
    { "role": "assistant", "content": "伦敦今天是多云，温度55°F，湿度60%。" }
  ],
  [
    { "role": "user", "content": "东京明天会下雨吗？" },
    { "role": "assistant", "content": null, "function_call": { "name": "get_current_weather", "arguments": "{\"location\":\"Tokyo, Japan\"}" } },
    { "role": "function", "name": "get_current_weather", "content": "{\"temperature\":70,\"description\":\"Rainy\",\"humidity\":80}" },
    { "role": "assistant", "content": "东京明天会下雨，温度70°F，湿度80%。" }
  ],
  [
    { "role": "user", "content": "北京现在的温度是多少摄氏度？" },
    { "role": "assistant", "content": null, "function_call": { "name": "get_current_weather", "arguments": "{\"location\":\"Beijing, China\", \"unit\":\"celsius\"}" } },
    { "role": "function", "name": "get_current_weather", "content": "{\"temperature\":22,\"description\":\"Clear\",\"humidity\":30}" },
    { "role": "assistant", "content": "北京现在是晴朗，温度22°C，湿度30%。" }
  ]
]
```

你可以根据需要自行扩展对话数量、地点或单位等信息。祝你使用愉快！
